Record Class ReactEvent

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.trevlar.menukit.window.ReactEvent
public record ReactEvent(Address address, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack before, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack after, ReactCause cause) extends Record
What a ReactiveHook receives when a slot's contents change. Carries the Address of the slot, an immutable before/after snapshot of its stack, and an extensible ReactCause — never the raw Slot (architecture Part 2 §6: the window works with a slot, never hands one out).

The snapshots are defensive copy()s taken at fire time, so a hook can read them freely without observing further mutation and without being able to mutate the live slot through them. before/after are ItemStack.EMPTY when the slot was/became empty, so an insert reads as before.isEmpty() and a take as after.isEmpty() (or shrunk).
